title: Carbon Dioxide Concentration - Comfort Levels
description: CO2 acceptance and comfort level calculator. Assess indoor air quality based on CO2 concentration levels and their effects on human health and comfort.

outputs.label: Comfort Level
outputs.formula: if(inputs.co2_concentration < 600, 'Acceptable', if(inputs.co2_concentration < 1000, 'Complaints of Stuffiness', if(inputs.co2_concentration < 2500, 'General Drowsiness', if(inputs.co2_concentration < 5000, 'Adverse Health Effects', if(inputs.co2_concentration < 10000, 'Maximum Working Period (8h)', 'Dangerous Levels')))))

outputs.label: Health Status
outputs.formula: if(inputs.co2_concentration < 450, 'Normal Outdoor Level', if(inputs.co2_concentration < 600, 'Acceptable for Most', if(inputs.co2_concentration < 1000, 'Complaints Expected', if(inputs.co2_concentration < 2500, 'Drowsiness Expected', if(inputs.co2_concentration < 5000, 'Health Effects Possible', if(inputs.co2_concentration < 30000, 'Severe Effects', 'Extreme Danger'))))))

outputs.label: Recommended Action
outputs.formula: if(inputs.co2_concentration < 1000, 'No action needed', if(inputs.co2_concentration < 5000, 'Increase ventilation', 'Evacuate and seek fresh air'))

components.content:
### Ventilation Conversion

1 cfm (cubic feet per minute) = 1.7 m³/h = 0.47 l/s
